phase_name: Uniform Bounded Timeouts Per Gate and Per Suite

objectives.description: Per-gate timeout enforcement via gate_registry_exec_bounded in gate-registry-lib.sh, sized from registry timeout_s values already populated
Per-suite timeout in run-all.sh, both sequential and parallel run_one() paths
Attributable, named timeout failure messages (gate id/invoke name + bound; suite name + bound)
Deliberately-stalled fixtures asserting bounds fire, name the right unit, and the run reaches a stable summary
Full battery run confirming no existing gate or suite trips its bound, and finding-set equivalence vs. Phase 5's capture

approaches_tried.approach: Suite-side deliberately-stalled fixture as a real discovered file (test-stalled-fixture.sh) in the real corpus, env-gated to be an instant pass when not activated
approaches_tried.reason: Unused by the final self-contained synthetic-fixture test cases (safer/isolated), and would have been an orphaned out-of-file_scope file plus a permanent (tiny) tax on every future real run-all.sh discovery; removed before commit in favor of the synthetic in-test fixtures only.
